decision.reason: Memory_clock has the lowest leave-trajectory-out NMSE by a wide margin and consistently predicts held-out interventions well. Residual autocorrelation remains, so adequacy for unseen interventions is not established.
decision.prediction: For a slow-wave input, predicted output will track both accumulated input history and elapsed-time phase; systematic residual oscillations would challenge adequacy.

mapping.target_relation: The predictive fit combines history and elapsed-time features but does not establish a distinct physical mechanism.
mapping.condition_to_check: Compare residual phase across different input interventions; phase that follows input history rather than elapsed time weakens an independent-clock account.
